property_summary: For any value sent, a call to C's fallback succeeds if and only if the value is exactly 10 ether; the mutant, having deleted the value check, succeeds for arbitrary values, so some non-10-ether call succeeds on the mutant while reverting on the reference.
change_summary: Delete the require(msg.value == 10 ether) check so calls with any value are accepted.
